title: Phantom Blade Zero Weapons Guide - All Weapons & Shachi System
description: Complete Phantom Blade Zero weapons guide. All 30+ main weapons, 20+ Shachi secondary weapons, weapon categories, and the dual-weapon combat system explained.

sections.title: Weapon System Overview
sections.content:
Phantom Blade Zero features a deep dual-weapon system with over 30 main weapons and 20+ Shachi (secondary) weapons. Players equip one main weapon and one Shachi weapon simultaneously, allowing for diverse combat combinations.

Key Features

  • Seamless weapon switching mid-combo
  • Boss-specific weapon drops
  • NPC vendors sell weapons throughout the world
  • Each weapon has unique attack patterns and techniques

sections.title: Main Weapon Categories
sections.content:
Main weapons are divided into 3 categories, each with a distinct combat feel:

CategoryWeapons CountAttack StyleSpeedRangeBest For
Regular Sword10+Balanced slashesMediumMediumAll-around combat, beginners
Long Sword10+Heavy overhead strikesSlowLongHigh damage per hit, breaking guards
Dual Swords10+Rapid multi-hit chainsFastShortCombo damage, speed-focused builds

Regular Sword

The balanced option. Regular Swords offer consistent damage, reasonable speed, and good range. Ideal for players who want versatility without committing to extremes. Parry windows are forgiving with this category.

Long Sword

Heavy and powerful. Long Swords deal massive damage per strike but have slower recovery. Best used when you can read enemy patterns and find windows for big hits. Excellent for breaking through enemy defenses.

Dual Swords

Fast and aggressive. Dual Swords enable rapid combo chains with many hits. While individual strikes deal less damage, the accumulated DPS rivals other categories. Requires getting close to enemies.

sections.title: Shachi Weapons (Secondary)
sections.content:
Shachi weapons occupy the secondary weapon slot and provide entirely different combat options from your main weapon. There are over 20 types ranging from ranged firearms to close-range specialty tools.

Known Shachi Types

  • Cannons — Ranged heavy damage, slow fire rate. Good for initiating fights.
  • Throwing Weapons — Mid-range options for keeping pressure at distance.
  • Close-range Techniques — Specialized martial arts tools for combo extensions.
  • Phantom Edges — Special ability weapons with unique techniques tied to each type.

How Shachi Works

Your Shachi weapon can be activated during combos, after parries, or as standalone actions. Each Shachi weapon has:

  • A basic attack (always available)
  • A special technique (on cooldown)
  • Synergy bonuses with certain main weapon categories

sections.title: How to Get Weapons
sections.content:
Weapon Sources

  • Boss Drops — Defeating bosses often rewards unique weapons not available elsewhere. These are typically among the strongest.
  • NPC Vendors — Merchants throughout the world sell weapons for currency. New stock may appear as you progress.
  • Exploration — Hidden weapons in secret areas, behind puzzles, or in hard-to-reach locations.
  • Story Rewards — Certain weapons are given during key story moments.

Complete weapon list with locations and stats will be added at launch.
